parameter_semantics: target_object selects observed red_pose; successor_object selects observed blue_pose; buffer_pose_world is the destination frame [x,y,z,qw,qx,qy,qz] in world metres/wxyz. Training binds [-0.181,0,0.02,1,0,0,0]. The pose directly defines action encoding, decoding and relational inputs.
output_semantics: Each slot is [local_x,local_y,local_z,rotvec_x,rotvec_y,rotvec_z,gripper], a Cartesian TCP pose in the supplied buffer destination frame. Translation is metres and rotation vector is radians. decode_action exponentiates the local rotation, composes buffer_pose_world, then exclusively calls panda_kinematics.solve_ik from fresh measured qpos. Native gripper sign is preserved. Slots are t-1..t+14 and execution uses slots 1..8.

conversion_check.description: FK command poses are converted by inverse(buffer) composition and SO(3) log, then exactly reconstructed by buffer composition and exponential map before shared IK. The independent check compares world TCP position, rotation and gripper.

cut_relation: All actions in every assigned [0,stop) occurrence remain supervised, including 210-230 actions overlapping place_blue from red lowering and release through blue closure and initial lift.
